parameters.jsCode: const row=$input.first()?.json;if(row?.budgetKey!=='mail-routing'||!Number.isInteger(Number(row.version)))throw Error('Routing budget singleton is missing; run the inactive one-time bootstrap first');return [{json:row}];

const items=$input.all();const limits={"modelRoutingAuthorized":false,"maxCallsPerRun":0,"maxInputTokensPerRun":0,"maxOutputTokensPerRun":0,"maxCostUsdPerRun":0,"maxCallsPerDay":0,"maxInputTokensPerDay":0,"maxOutputTokensPerDay":0,"maxCostUsdPerDay":0,"maxCostUsdPerMonth":0};if(!limits.modelRoutingAuthorized)throw Error('Recurring model routing has not been authorized');let inputTokens=0;for(const x of items)inputTokens+=Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(x.json._openaiRequest),'utf8')+1024;const estimate={calls:items.length,inputTokens,outputTokens:items.length*512,costUsd:((inputTokens*.20/1000000)+(items.length*512*1.20/1000000))*1.25};if(estimate.calls>limits.maxCallsPerRun||estimate.inputTokens>limits.maxInputTokensPerRun||estimate.outputTokens>limits.maxOutputTokensPerRun||estimate.costUsd>limits.maxCostUsdPerRun)throw Error('Per-run routing ceiling exceeded before any model call');return [{json:{estimate,items:items.map(x=>x.json),limits}}];

const row=$input.first()?.json??{};const plan=$('Prepare optimistic budget reservation').first().json;if(row.reservationId!==plan.reservationId||Number(row.version)!==Number(plan.version))throw Error('Concurrent routing budget reservation lost; no model call allowed');return plan._batch.map(json=>({json}));

const expected=$('Prepare model row claims').all();if($input.all().length!==expected.length)throw Error('Model claim write count mismatch');return [{json:{routingRunId:expected[0].json.routingRunId}}];

const rows=$input.all().filter(row=>row.json?.recordId);const expected=$('Prepare model row claims').all();const actualIds=rows.map(row=>row.json.recordId).sort();const expectedIds=expected.map(row=>row.json.recordId).sort();if(JSON.stringify(actualIds)!==JSON.stringify(expectedIds))throw Error('Exclusive staged-row claim failed; no model call allowed');return expected;

return $input.all().map(item=>{const d=item.json._routing.decision;const f=d.feedback;const u=item.json._usage??{};const source=item.json;const input=Number(u.prompt_tokens);const output=Number(u.completion_tokens);if(!Number.isFinite(input)||!Number.isFinite(output))throw Error('Provider usage is required for persistent routing cost provenance');const nominalCostUsd=input*.20/1000000+output*1.20/1000000;return {json:{recordId:source.recordId,messageId:source.messageId,sender:source.sender,subject:source.subject,body:source.body,receivedAt:source.receivedAt,sourceUrl:source.sourceUrl,contentDigest:source.contentDigest,state:'routed-awaiting-delivery',category:d.category,routingMethod:d.method,reasonCode:d.reasonCode,confidence:d.confidence,model:'gpt-5.6-luna',routedAt:new Date().toISOString(),dashboardRecordId:'',attemptCount:Number(source.attemptCount||0),lastErrorClass:'',lastErrorAt:'',routingRunId:source.routingRunId,reservedAt:source.reservedAt,modelInputTokens:input,modelOutputTokens:output,modelCostUsd:nominalCostUsd,feedbackEnvironment:f.environment,feedbackInterpretation:f.interpretation,feedbackEvidenceQuotes:JSON.stringify(f.evidenceQuotes),feedbackRationale:f.rationale,feedbackContext:f.context,intendedExperienceReference:f.intendedExperienceReference??''}};});

const allowed=['beta','purchases','errors','infrastructure','support','unsorted'];return $input.all().map(item=>{const row=item.json;if(row.state!=='routed-awaiting-delivery'||!allowed.includes(row.category))throw Error('Only a persisted six-bucket decision may be delivered');if(!row.messageId||!row.recordId||!row.contentDigest)throw Error('Routed ledger row is incomplete');const payload={source:'secdash-mail',messageId:row.messageId,sender:row.sender,subject:row.subject,body:row.body,receivedAt:row.receivedAt,category:row.category,supportKind:null,sourceUrl:row.sourceUrl||null};if(row.feedbackEnvironment){let evidenceQuotes;try{evidenceQuotes=JSON.parse(row.feedbackEvidenceQuotes||'[]');}catch{throw Error('Persisted feedback evidence is invalid JSON');}if(!Array.isArray(evidenceQuotes))throw Error('Persisted feedback evidence is not an array');payload.feedback={environment:row.feedbackEnvironment,interpretation:row.feedbackInterpretation,evidenceQuotes,rationale:row.feedbackRationale,context:row.feedbackContext,intendedExperienceReference:row.intendedExperienceReference||null};}return {json:{...row,_deliveryPayload:payload}};});

return $input.all().map(item=>{const source=item.json._deliverySource;const ack=item.json._deliveryAck;if(!source||ack?.stored!==true||typeof ack.id!=='string'||!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(ack.id))throw Error('Dashboard did not acknowledge the stable message delivery');if(ack.id!==source.recordId)throw Error('Dashboard acknowledgement does not match the stable record ID');return {json:{...source,state:'delivered',dashboardRecordId:ack.id,lastErrorClass:'',lastErrorAt:''}};});

const rows=$input.all();for(const row of rows)if(row.json?.state!=='delivered'||row.json?.dashboardRecordId!==row.json?.recordId)throw Error('Ledger terminal update was not confirmed');return rows.map(row=>({json:{completed:true,recordId:row.json.recordId,category:row.json.category,state:'delivered',modelCalls:row.json.routingMethod==='model'?1:0}}));
